content_types.name: Chart of the Day

content_types.name: Macro Note

content_types.name: Report Card

content_types.name: On Our Radar

featured_charts.body: Director Shepherd Brian A. bought 7,120 shares of LRN at an average $76.5, roughly $545K. The purchase took the disclosed holding to 7.5x its previous size. The relative change is the part that matters, not the dollar headline.
